Every name below is importable from the package it is listed under. Each group links to the page that explains it; the signatures and arguments are in the names' docstrings.

[]{#declared-public-exports}

## Build a plan: `scgsim.geometry` {#scgsim.geometry}

**The plan.** Build the layout's plan and freeze it into a snapshot. [Reference](specs/geometry-plan.qmd)

`GeometryPlan`, `GeometryPlanSnapshot`, `SemanticEntitySpec`, `VacuumRegionSpec`.

**Lumped elements.** Declare each lumped element once, on the plan: an R, L, C element or an excitation port on an authored sheet. [Reference](specs/geometry-plan.qmd#lumped-elements)

`JunctionTerminalBinding`, `LumpedElement`, `LumpedElementRecord`, `LumpedPort`, `RectangularJunctionSpec`, `with_rectangular_junctions`.

**Curves.** Declare exact lines and circular arcs on the layout's outlines. [Reference](specs/geometry-plan.qmd#source-curves)

`BoundaryCurveChainSpec`, `Coordinate`, `CurveKindLiteral`, `CurveOrientationLiteral`, `GdsBoundaryReconstructionSpec`, `PathInput`, `PolygonRing`, `SourceCurveSpec`, `Vector3D`.

**Films and profiles.** Choose how each film becomes a sheet or a volume. [Reference](specs/physical-representation.qmd)

`ApproximationProfile`, `PhysicalLayerDeclaration`, `PhysicalRepresentationPlan`, `RouteLiteral`, `interpret_physical_geometry`, `interpret_physical_layers`.

**Normalized input.** The normalized input a snapshot carries, and its summary. [Reference](specs/geometry-plan.qmd#pre-solve-input-summary)

`GeometryBuildInput`, `InputSummary`, `LayoutPolygonSpec`, `PortSheetOverlapRecord`, `PortSheetRegionRecord`, `apply_vacuum_region_to_stack`, `build_gds_stack_geometry_input`, `summarize_geometry_input`.

## Simulate with Palace: `scgsim.palace` {#scgsim.palace}

**Simulations.** Set up, check and prepare a capacitance, eigenmode or S-parameter run. [Reference](specs/palace-electrostatic-sgb.qmd)

`DrivenSim`, `EigenmodeSim`, `ElectrostaticSim`, `SimulationDrcError`, `SimulationDrcReport`.

**Convergence.** Declare when adaptive refinement has converged. [Reference](specs/palace-electrostatic-sgb.qmd#convergence-declaration)

`Capacitance`, `ConvergenceCheck`, `ConvergencePlan`, `ConvergenceVerdict`, `Criterion`, `CriterionGroup`, `ErrorIndicator`, `ModeFrequency`, `SurfaceEpr`.

**Read a run.** Read a returned run folder and its records. [Reference](specs/report-model.qmd)

`PalaceFailureDiagnosis`, `PalaceProvenance`, `PalaceResultSelection`, `PalaceReturnedReceipt`, `ParsedTable`, `ResolvedPalaceResult`, `SolverEnd`, `StageResult`, `inspect_run_trustworthiness`, `resolve_palace_result`.

**Reports.** The run, physics and cost views of a result. [Reference](specs/report-model.qmd#common-envelope)

`PalaceCost`, `PalacePerformance`, `PalaceTrustReport`, `PassCostRecord`, `PhysicsQuantitiesReport`, `SimulationBenchmarkReport`, `SurfaceMarginEprRecord`, `SurfaceMarginEprSeriesSnapshot`.

**EPR.** Detach, reread, reanalyze and plot an EPR result. [Reference](specs/palace-eigenmode.qmd#results-and-offline-analysis)

`PalaceEprResult`, `epr_result`, `reanalyze_epr`, `resolve_epr_result`, `show_epr`.

## Simulate with AEDT: `scgsim.aedt` {#scgsim.aedt}

**Preparation.** Build the SGB model of a plan, its lumped elements included, and prepare an HFSS, Q3D or Q2D handoff. [Reference](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#one-shared-lifecycle)

`EigenmodeSim`, `HandoffPlan`, `PreparedSgbModel`, `SimulationDrcReport`, `parse_aedt_spec`, `prepare_handoff`, `prepare_hfss_driven_from_geometry`, `prepare_hfss_eigenmode_from_geometry`, `prepare_q3d_from_geometry`.

**Request specs.** The request each AEDT calculation is prepared from. [Reference](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#solver-specific-contracts)

`AedtSpec`, `HfssDrivenGeometrySpec`, `HfssEprAnalysisSpec`, `HfssEprSpec`, `HfssSpec`, `PdkMaterial`, `Q2dConductorSpec`, `Q2dRectangleSpec`, `Q2dSpec`, `Q3dNetSpec`, `Q3dSpec`.

**Wave and modal ports.** Ports on the Region's faces, refused until issue #135; lumped elements are the plan's. [Reference](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#hfss-driven-terminal-sgb)

`ModalPort`, `TerminalPort`.

**Run controls.** Setup, sweep and resources of a solve. [Reference](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#aedt-family-setup-controls)

`AedtResources`, `EigenmodeRunControl`, `FrequencySweepSpec`, `HfssRunControl`, `MatrixRunControl`.

**EPR.** Request, converge on, compute again and plot energy participation. [Reference](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#eigenmode-saved-fields-and-surface-epr-direction)

`EprAnalysisRequest`, `EprResult`, `ExpressionCacheConvergence`, `ExpressionCacheConvergenceSet`, `NativeExpressionDefinition`, `NormalizedSurfaceEprTotal`, `SavedSolution`, `analyze_epr`, `plot_epr_result`, `reanalyze_epr`, `resolve_epr_result`, `resolve_saved_solution`, `show_epr`.

**Batch solve on another host.** Package an HFSS EPR model, solve it, and collect it. [Reference](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#prepared-native-hfss-epr-batch)

`NativeBatchPackage`, `collect_native_batch`, `prepare_native_batch`, `run_native_batch`.

**Results and control.** Read a returned run, a prepared model, or stop a Q3D run. [Reference](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#q3d-user-requested-stopabort-and-save)

`PreparedModel`, `ResolvedRun`, `StageResult`, `request_q3d_abort_and_save`, `request_q3d_stop_and_save`, `resolve_prepared_model`, `resolve_results`.

## AEDT specs module: `scgsim.aedt.specs` {#scgsim.aedt.specs}

**Driven Terminal specs.** The Driven Terminal request and the wave port record, importable from the specs module. [Reference](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#hfss-driven-terminal-sgb)

`HfssDrivenGeometrySpec`, `TerminalPort`.

## Preview the geometry: `scgsim.visualization` {#scgsim.visualization}

**Preview.** Look at the geometry a solver will use, before it runs. [Reference](../guides/preview-the-geometry.qmd)

`GeometryPreview`, `GeometryPreviewArtifact`, `inspect_aedt_geometry`, `inspect_palace_geometry`.

## Semantic snapshots: `scgsim.semantics` {#scgsim.semantics}

**Snapshots.** Hashable snapshots of semantic facts, for tool and PDK authors. [Reference](../contribute/architecture.qmd)

`SemanticFactsSnapshot`, `SemanticSnapshotReference`, `canonical_sha256`, `create_snapshot`.
